THE FIRST STATUTES
1. Faculties. There shall be a Faculty of Arts and a Dean of that Faculty.
1. Short title. This Act may be called the Example College Act, 2018 and it shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions. In this Act, Board means the Board of the College established under this Act.
3. Repeal. The Ordinance of 2010 is hereby repealed and this Act shall prevail over that Ordinance.
